name: Economic profit
equation: Non-financials: (ROIC - WACC) x average IC = NOPAT - WACC x average IC (defined even when IC <= 0); financials: (ROE - Ke) x average equity

name: Revenue CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (Revenue_t / Revenue_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: EBITDA CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (EBITDA_t / EBITDA_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: PAT CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (PAT_t / PAT_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: EPS CAGR (full span, up to 10y)
note: CAGR over 9 years (FY17-FY26); export holds 10 annual points
equation: (EPS_t / EPS_t-n)^(1/n) - 1, n = full available span <= 10; n/m if either value <= 0

name: Revenue growth volatility
equation: sd(g_t) / |mean(g_t)| over the last 10 annual growth rates (>= 4 needed); n/m if |mean| < 1%

name: PAT growth volatility
equation: sd(g_t) / |mean(g_t)| of core PAT growth over the last 10 years (base year PAT > 0); n/m if |mean| < 1%

name: Quarterly YoY growth trend
equation: OLS slope of the last 4 values of (Revenue_q / Revenue_q-4 - 1), per quarter

name: Constant-currency growth
equation: Revenue growth at constant exchange rates (reported)

name: Deal TCV growth
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: EBITDA margin
equation: EBITDA / Revenue, EBITDA = Revenue - (materials + employee + other opex)

name: EBIT margin
equation: EBIT / Revenue, EBIT = core PBT + interest = EBITDA - depreciation + core other income

name: Other expenses % of sales
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored
equation: (Power & fuel + Other mfr. + Selling & admin + Other expenses) / Revenue

name: Degree of operating leverage
equation: %change EBIT / %change Revenue (n/m if |%change revenue| < 2% or prior EBIT <= 0)

name: EBITDA margin volatility (sd)
equation: sd(EBITDA margin_t) over the last 10 years (>= 4 needed, sample sd)

name: Other income / PBT
equation: Other income (reported, incl. exceptional) / PBT (reported); n/m if PBT <= 0

name: Latest quarter EBITDA margin change YoY
equation: OPM_q - OPM_q-4, OPM = operating profit / revenue

name: Asset turnover
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: Fixed-asset turnover
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: Invested-capital turnover
equation: Revenue / average invested capital, IC = equity + borrowings - cash - investments (n/m if IC <= 0)

name: Net working capital days
equation: (Other assets - cash - other liabilities) / Revenue x 365

name: Other assets (loans, advances, other) / sales
equation: average Other assets (loans, advances, other) / Revenue

name: Utilisation
note: n/a in FY26: missing utilisation_pct FY26 (manual KPI)
equation: Billed effort / available effort (reported, ex trainees)

name: Attrition (LTM)
equation: Voluntary leavers over the last 12 months / average headcount (reported)

name: Revenue per employee
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: Return on equity
equation: core PAT / average equity (share capital + reserves)

name: Return on assets
note: no sourced band and fewer than 4 same-archetype peers: level not scored

name: Return on capital employed
equation: EBIT / average (equity + borrowings), EBIT = core PBT + interest

name: Return on invested capital
equation: NOPAT / average IC; NOPAT = (EBITDA - Dep) x (1 - ETR), ETR = core tax / core PBT clipped 0-40% (statutory if PBT <= 0); IC = equity + borrowings - cash - investments (+ manual minority interest); n/m if IC <= 0

name: ROIC - WACC
equation: ROIC - WACC (WACC from config/market.yaml, see capital_cost.py)

name: Incremental ROIC 3y
equation: (NOPAT_t - NOPAT_t-3) / (avg IC_t - avg IC_t-3); n/m if capital grew < 5%

name: Receivables growth - revenue growth
equation: (Rec_t / Rec_t-1 - 1) - (Rev_t / Rev_t-1 - 1); n/m if prior receivables < 0.5% of revenue

name: Exceptional items frequency (5y)
equation: count over last 5 years of [|estimated exceptional| > 5% x |PBT|]

name: Beneish AQI
equation: [1 - (CA_t + NB_t)/TA_t] / [1 - (CA_t-1 + NB_t-1)/TA_t-1], CA proxy = receivables + inventory + cash

name: Beneish DEPI
equation: DepRate_t-1 / DepRate_t, DepRate = Dep / (Dep + Net block)

name: Beneish SGAI
equation: (SGA_t/Sales_t) / (SGA_t-1/Sales_t-1), SGA proxy = selling & admin + other expenses (other opex if that is <= 0)

name: Interest cover
equation: EBIT / Interest, EBIT = core PBT + interest; = 99 if interest ~ 0; clipped to [-99, 99]

name: Cash / short-term borrowings
equation: Cash & bank / short-term borrowings (manual) or / Borrowings; = 99 when there is no debt

name: Debt growth - EBITDA growth
equation: (Borrowings_t/Borrowings_t-1 - 1) - (EBITDA_t/EBITDA_t-1 - 1); n/m if prior debt < 1% of assets or prior EBITDA <= 0

name: Reinvestment rate
equation: (Capex proxy - Depreciation + change in NWC) / NOPAT (NOPAT > 0); NWC = other assets - cash - other liabilities

name: Buyback (estimate)
equation: max(0, -(Adj shares_t - Adj shares_t-1)) x (Price_t + Price_t-1)/2

name: Dividends / FCF
equation: Dividend / (CFO - capex proxy); 99 if FCF <= 0 and dividend > 0; 0 if no dividend

name: ROIC change after acquisition spend
note: no value for the as-of year
equation: ROIC_t - ROIC_t-3 if non_capex_investing_3y > 10%, else n/a

name: Promoter holding change 3y
note: no value for the as-of year

name: Promoter pledge
note: no value for the as-of year

name: P/E
note: current = market cap / FY26 annual PAT (core)
equation: Market cap / core PAT (current: TTM PAT when available)

name: P/E percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end P/E below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: P/B percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end P/B below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: EV/EBITDA
note: current = EV (export price, FY26 debt/cash/investments) / TTM from last 4 quarters EBITDA
equation: EV / EBITDA, EV = market cap + borrowings - cash - investments

name: EV/EBITDA percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end EV/EBITDA below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: EV/Sales
note: current = EV / TTM from last 4 quarters revenue

name: EV/Sales percentile vs own history
equation: (# historical FY-end EV/Sales below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values

name: Reverse-DCF implied FCF growth (10y)
note: solved; EV 869,850 cr, NOPAT 50,437 cr, base FCF 46,759 cr, WACC 12.47%, RONIC 82.3%, terminal g 6.0%, 10y
equation: solve g: EV = sum_{t=1..10} F0(1+g)^t/(1+WACC)^t + F10(1+gT)/((WACC-gT)(1+WACC)^10), F0 = NOPAT0 x (1 - gT/RONIC), RONIC = 3y avg ROIC (capped at 100%)

name: Implied - delivered growth
equation: implied_growth_reverse_dcf - 5y NOPAT CAGR (revenue CAGR 5y if NOPAT CAGR is n/m)

name: Justified P/B
equation: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g); ROE = 3y avg, g = min(ROE x (1 - 3y avg payout), terminal g)

name: (EV/IC) / (ROIC/WACC)
equation: (EV / IC) / (ROIC / WACC), ROIC = latest, WACC = current
